title.narrative: Global Quality and Standards Programme Indonesia (GQSP) Indonesia Phase 2 # Extension

description.narrative: The Global Quality and Standards Programme Indonesia or called GQSP Indonesia Phase 2 (2023-2027) is part of the UNIDO-SECO GQSP Global Programme Phase II. The GQSP Indonesia Phase 2 or SMART-Fish 3, is the extension of the previous programme to strengthen the foundations that have been laid down during the GQSP Phase 1 and to deepen the intervention for the transformation of the selected value chains, not only into sustainable practices but also strengthen their ecosystem services role, including contribution to climate change mitigation and adaptation.
